schema_check.command:
python -B - <<'PY'
import json
from pathlib import Path
import jsonschema
ars=Path('/root/autodl-tmp/.codex/plugins/cache/ars-codex/ars-codex/0.1.28/skills/academic-research-suite/ars')
rows=[]
for slug,patch in [('31-level11-conjugacy-owner-ledger','stage4_5_round3_e6_restoration_caller_bound_patch.json'),('32-homology-cover-renormalization-uniformity','stage4_5_round3_e6_restoration_patch.json')]:
    note=Path('papers')/slug/'notes'
    for p,s in [(note/'stage4_5_round3_e6_restoration_issue_list.json',ars/'shared/contracts/revision/integrity_correction_list.schema.json'),(note/patch,ars/'shared/contracts/patch/revision_patch.schema.json')]:
        schema=json.loads(s.read_bytes())
        jsonschema.Draft202012Validator.check_schema(schema)
        jsonschema.Draft202012Validator(schema).validate(json.loads(p.read_bytes()))
        rows.append({'path':str(p),'schema':str(s),'status':'VALID_CURRENT_SCHEMA'})
print(json.dumps({'status':'PASS_SCHEMA_ONLY_NOT_APPLICATION_AUTHORIZATION','rows':rows}))
PY
